question: Should `streaming.preview.toolProgress: false` continue to deliver separate Codex tool-progress messages, and should the permanent Codex-to-channel intent live in a typed shared reply-payload contract?
rationale: The PR changes configured user-visible delivery behavior and establishes a cross-plugin contract, so maintainers must confirm the compatibility policy and owner boundary before implementation can be finalized.

options.title: Preserve documented mode
options.body: Keep separate progress deliverable when configured and add a typed shared progress intent consumed by Slack.

options.title: Retire separate progress
options.body: Suppress these summaries in every mode, update the documented contract, and provide explicit upgrade evidence.

recommendation.title: Preserve documented mode
recommendation.body: Keep separate progress deliverable when configured and add a typed shared progress intent consumed by Slack.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to Slack progress rendering, suppression, and live transport validation.
